traits.name: Avoidance.
traits.text: If the displacer beast is subjected to an attack, it has advantage on its next attack roll against that attacker.

traits.name: Displacement.
traits.text: The displacer beast projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location. Attack rolls against the beast have disadvantage unless the attacker can see through illusions.

actions.name: Multiattack.
actions.text: The displacer beast makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tentacle.

actions.name: Bite.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
